title: Migration 17 — procurement decisions (first execution of its rollback)
description: Applies the base schema, the farmer MVP, migration 9 and migration 10, then migration 17, and rolls 17 back. 17 records who authorised each buyer-pack release and why, with a trigger making the table append-only and a CHECK requiring a non-empty reason. It depends on migration 10 because procurement_decisions.snapshot_id references buyer_pack_snapshots. Like 10 and 23, its ROLLBACK had never been executed anywhere before this fixture (defect D6). It is also the first fixture whose rollback drops a VIEW — procurement_decisions_current — which the catalog snapshot could not see at all until the D7 work, since the table branch matches relkind r/p only.
